title: Braille dice for blind children
text: Generates OpenSCAD code for a set of d8 dice with braille on each face, for a scrabble-like game for blind children, correcting rotations from screenshots.

title: Parametric desk tray shelf
text: Writes an OpenSCAD file for a stackable desk tray shelf, iterates on it over an evening with small prototype prints, then prints three full-size shelves.

title: Printable enclosure from PSU spec sheet
text: Turns a power supply spec sheet plus port and gland requirements into a printable enclosure, with screw holes, mounts and grills, by iterating through OpenSCAD tools unassisted.

title: Star-shaped lampshade from a graph image
text: Derives an equation from an image of a star-shaped graph and generates an OpenSCAD lampshade that tapers upward, with an opening at the top for a bulb fixture.

title: Connectors for nebulizer hacks
text: Creates OpenSCAD designs for hacked connectors that fit vibrating mesh nebulizers, checking each result by hand before printing.

title: Rope-driven robot joint
text: Builds a capstan, rope-driven joint for robotics as OpenSCAD code, working through repeated design iterations.

title: Custom project enclosures via CadQuery
text: Generates CadQuery scripts that export STL files and preview images for custom project enclosures, then prints them; three or four have been made this way.

title: Buildings designed as OpenSCAD files
text: Designs buildings by generating OpenSCAD files, after finding that code-driven 3D design avoids learning a conventional CAD application.

title: Home attachments and affordances
text: Produces build123d and OpenSCAD designs for attachments and fittings around a home from described needs and measurements, then prints and installs them.

title: Multicolor name tags for Bambu
text: Writes OpenSCAD scripts where each colour becomes a separate object on export, so multicolour tag keys can be printed with different filaments.

title: Printed case and milled hotend adapter
text: Designs three parts in FreeCAD from part numbers and caliper readings: a printed case for an OLED display and ESP32, a milled aluminium hotend mount, and a pen mount.

title: Arcade button with custom chip and case
text: Designs a custom circuit board with a KiCad server and a printed enclosure through a Blender server for a big red arcade button that plays a sound clip.

title: Papercraft unfolding tool
text: Builds an unfolder for designing papercraft shapes with children, as a Linux alternative to a commercial papercraft tool, using a Java stack and an STL viewer.

title: Gear generator for machining
text: Writes a program that outputs STL, DXF and SVG files of involute gears for machining or 3D printing, with a gear designer interface and visual preview.

title: Two first PCBs from generated KiCad sources
text: Writes a Python script that generates KiCad schematics and board files from a shared netlist, validates with the KiCad command line, and orders two working boards.

title: WiFi fan speed controller board
text: Designs an ESP32 fan speed controller circuit for KiCad 10 with parts selection and writes the ESP-IDF software, finishing the schematic in about twenty minutes.

title: Cheaper BOM and board redesign
text: Redesigns a new KiCad board with parts selected from JLCPCB, swaps in cheaper components, then reworks the schematic to use through-hole parts for blank-board ordering.

title: KiCad symbols and footprints from datasheets
text: Reads uploaded datasheets and writes a complete KiCad symbol, footprint and sometimes a 3D body for each part.

title: Autorouter benchmark for a bench board
text: Benchmarks several KiCad autorouting tools on a circuit board, then lets the builder pick and tweak the best routes before ordering the board.

title: LED totem for Burning Man
text: Explores the shape of a balloon-animal-style LED camel totem for Burning Man through design conversations before building it.

title: Windowshade motor controller board
text: Designs the motor controller board for a Zigbee retrofit of IKEA window shades, working within a tight space constraint.

title: KiCad PCB utility for LED enclosure
text: Builds a small utility for generating KiCad boards from YAML and matches an LED board layout to an enclosure design through a FreeCAD server.

title: Routed boards with pinned key traces
text: Pins key traces through the KiCad Python API and hands remaining nets to an autorouter, producing better-looking routes for a 38-pin connector when pushed.

title: Firmware, board changes and installer docs
text: Finishes a project across firmware in Rust, component changes on the board, sourcing of non-PCB parts and installer documentation.

title: Plasma-cut steel from direct G-code
text: Writes Python that generates and debugs toolpaths for a CNC plasma cutter, so that the resulting shape is cut in steel without CAD or CAM.

title: Historic guitar tuner replicas
text: Codes a modern replica of 1760s guitar tuners in build123d, then has the STEP output CNC cut and fitted to an instrument.

title: Cat food dispenser in CadQuery
text: Writes CadQuery code for a dispenser that fits a brand of single-serve cat food containers.

title: ESP32 project cases in CadQuery
text: Writes CadQuery scripts for cases that fit assorted ESP32 projects, refining dimensions through repeated rendering and visualization.

title: Jewelry CAD description language
text: Writes a small description language for science-inspired jewelry and an interpreter that generates CAD files using CadQuery.

title: Sidecar ESP32 hardware devices
text: Builds custom ESP32 sidecar devices, pairing code with 3D printed housings, as an alternative to full-computer cyberdecks.

title: Sixty-part printed project
text: Generates a directory of text-based 3D designs with a make rule per part, parameters at the top, and prints a project of about sixty parts.

title: Place files from Gerber overlays
text: Writes software that renders Gerber files, overlays a second Gerber with exact alignment, and exports component centroids and rotations to a pick-and-place file.

title: Cleaning scanned STL files
text: Cleans up messy STL files produced by phone 3D scans of real objects so they can be printed.

title: Screenless story box with custom PCB
text: Builds a screenless NFC story box for children with an ESP32, a custom KiCad board and a printed housing, using help to double-check the math.

title: Board designed with no manual edits
text: Designs a custom circuit board from scratch under a no-manual-edits rule and has it manufactured, with a second system writing its software.

title: Enclosure parts via weekend OpenSCAD
text: Generates an OpenSCAD file for enclosure parts, exports an STL and sends it to a printer within minutes, then iterates after the first print.

title: Render-and-rotate loop for printable parts
text: Iterates on an OpenSCAD design by rendering and rotating PNG previews before producing the STL for printing.

title: Board game card holders
text: Designs small card holders for a board game from descriptions and prints them on a home printer.

title: STL generator scripts for slicer
text: Writes Python scripts from described requirements that generate the STL, then rescales it in the slicer before printing.

title: Sketch-based parametric parts
text: Writes parametric OpenSCAD part designs in metric units from hand-drawn sketches added to the context.

title: CadQuery to Fusion 360 handoff
text: Designs parts in CadQuery, then imports the STEP file into Fusion 360 so that further changes can be made by hand.

title: Fixing an EAGLE board by script
text: Routes a circuit board by writing a Python program that works directly on an EAGLE board file.

title: Library parts from a part number
text: Adds a named microcontroller part to a KiCad library as a schematic symbol and footprint with fields matching an organisation's internal standards.

title: Pi Pico HDMI CEC adapter
text: Writes firmware for a Raspberry Pi Pico soldered into a DisplayPort-to-HDMI adapter to add CEC support to a display setup.

title: Custom ESPHome sensors and actuators
text: Builds custom sensors and actuators for a smart-home setup, keeping a folder of ESPHome configurations for each device.

title: Bike pump wall mount attempt
text: Attempts to design a wall mount for a bike pump in OpenSCAD or CadQuery from photos and a written description, comparing outputs.

title: Soap mold in OpenSCAD
text: Tries to design a simple soap mold with rounded shapes in OpenSCAD from a text description, but the rounded form comes out wrong.

title: Prototype ring holder with threads
text: Iterates through eight printed prototypes of a threaded container, taking a sketch as the starting point and revising from test reports.

title: Printable sailboat hull
text: Designs a parametric toy sailboat hull in OpenSCAD, shaping the geometry so the hull can be printed without supports.

title: Balloon tracker four-layer board
text: Designs a four-layer board for a high altitude balloon tracker with transmitter, GPS and sensors, trading off size, power, RF filtering and extreme cold.

title: LED earring circuit board
text: Designs a rechargeable LED earring board with a coin cell, an RP2350 microcontroller, an IMU and 45 addressable LEDs, leaving two footprint mistakes to fix.

title: Sunglasses case insert
text: Reverse-engineers the geometry of a smart glasses case to design a sturdier printed insert, presenting orientations to choose from and reducing 3D problems to 2D.

title: Gridfinity bases for objects
text: Generates Gridfinity bases sized to given object dimensions through a CAD server, and prints about five of them.

title: Compost bin bag ring
text: Writes JavaScript that generates a printable ring to hold down the plastic bag in a compost bin.

title: Keepy-uppy paddle game
text: Wires and programs an Arduino toy for a child, a paddle game, using step-by-step wiring tutorials and one-shot code.

title: Board with UART wiring
text: Designs a circuit board with PCB layout help, producing an error that swaps receive and transmit on a UART line.
